definitions.gloss: dropping out, leaving school before graduation
definitions.explanation: Withdrawing from a school or university before completing the course of study. Short for {中途|ちゅうと}{退学|たいがく}.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}を{中退|ちゅうたい}した。
{高校|こうこう}{中退|ちゅうたい}から{社長|しゃちょう}になった。
examples.english: He went from high school dropout to company president.

examples.japanese: {経済的|けいざいてき}な{理由|りゆう}で{大学|だいがく}を{中退|ちゅうたい}せざるを{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: I had no choice but to drop out of college for financial reasons.

notes:
FORMS:
Short for {中途|ちゅうと}{退学|たいがく} (leaving school midway).

USAGE:
On resumes, {中退|ちゅうたい} is listed after the school name (e.g., 〇〇{大学|だいがく}{中退|ちゅうたい}). It is not inherently negative and some successful people are known as {中退|ちゅうたい}{者|しゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大学|だいがく}{中退|ちゅうたい}: college dropout
- {高校|こうこう}{中退|ちゅうたい}: high school dropout
- {中退|ちゅうたい}{者|しゃ}: person who dropped out
- {中退|ちゅうたい}{率|りつ}: dropout rate
